title: refactor(objectql): move the lifecycle health bodies out of engine.ts into engine-lifecycle-health.ts (#25522 cut 3)
body:
Part of #25522
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

Cut 3 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6386147359`. Two public `ObjectQL` method bodies move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-lifecycle-health.ts`: `checkDriversHealth` and `resolvePrimaryDatasource`. `init` stays: its return type is inferred. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/issue-25522-objectql-engine-cut-3`, cut from `origin/main` at `24d350b45`. Since then `main` has moved five commits (to `b2909fd46`). None touches `packages/objectql/src/**`; #25657 changes `packages/objectql/package.json`'s zod range only. The branch has not been merged forward; CI builds the merge ref.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs (A1).** At start, none of the 14 open PRs touched `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (every file list read through the REST API, the 183-file Version Packages PR #25640 page by page). Just before this PR was opened I measured again: 10 PRs are open, and none touches it (the two new ones, #25682 and #25684, read file by file; the other 8 unchanged).

## What moves, re-measured on `origin/main` `24d350b45`

The cut-2 dev proposed this area in PR #25636's body. I measured it again before moving anything, and every premise holds:

- **Both are public with explicit return types:** `checkDriversHealth(opts?: { timeoutMs?: number })`, which returns a `Promise` of `DriverHealth[]`, and `resolvePrimaryDatasource(): PrimaryDatasourceVerdict`. The stubs keep both signatures, so the `.d.ts` keeps its bytes (measured below).
- **0 lines from the last 30 days.** `git blame --since=2026-09-24T16:00Z` over both methods, docblocks included (156 lines), finds 0 recent lines. Control on the same blame: the whole file has 8,293 recent lines. History was deepened to 2026-09-15 first (126 commits touch the file in 30 days, 35 in 7).
- **No `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, and no static read.** `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES` is a module import from `@objectstack/spec/system`, not a class static. It has no other reader in `engine.ts`, so it leaves `engine.ts`'s import and the new module imports it.
- **No `engine.ts#…` path reader** for either symbol anywhere in the repo (`packages/spec/liveness/**`, `scripts/**`, `docs/**`, `content/**`).
- **No spy and no instance double on a real engine.** The two names appear in tests only as direct calls on a real engine (`engine-driver-health.test.ts`, `engine-primary-datasource.test.ts`, `engine-driver-eviction.test.ts`, `datasource-unavailable.test.ts`) or as whole-engine fakes (`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ready.test.ts`), which never reach `ObjectQL`.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1 and 2 apply it)

- The class keeps each method with its name, signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25522 cut 3]`.
- `LifecycleHealthHost` is new. It types each member as the class member itself (`ObjectQL['drivers']`, `ObjectQL['_registry']`, `ObjectQL['isSystemLedgerObject']`, `ObjectQL['resolveDatasourceBinding']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads, and each stub annotates its literal as the `ThisParameterType` of the moved function. There is no cast, and no member becomes public or protected.
- **Fields go as getters:** `drivers` (both bodies) and `_registry` (`resolvePrimaryDatasource`). Each read happens when the body makes it, so a driver registered or evicted later is seen as before.
- **Methods go as late-bound closures:** `isSystemLedgerObject` and `resolveDatasourceBinding`. A double set on the instance is still the one the body calls.
- `checkDriversHealth` stays `async` on both the stub and the moved function, so a throw inside the body is still a rejected promise.
- **Imports.** The module imports `ObjectQL` as a type only, so there is no module cycle at run time. It imports `DriverHealth` and `PrimaryDatasourceVerdict` as types from `./driver-connect-errors.js` and `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES` from `@objectstack/spec/system`, the specifiers `engine.ts` uses. `engine.ts` gains one import and drops `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES` from its `@objectstack/spec/system` import, its only other reader being a backticked docblock mention. Nothing re-exports the module.

## Net lines (this seat's rule: an area moves only when `engine.ts` shrinks)

| | base `24d350b45` | head |
|---|---|---|
| `engine.ts` (`wc -l`) | 23,807 | 23,755 (−52) |
| `engine-lifecycle-health.ts` | — | 143 |

Diff: +163 / −72 over 2 files, under the 3,000-line manual-merge line.

## The published `.d.ts` does not change (ruling `6348891160`)

Base: the `@objectstack/objectql` dependency closure built at this branch (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql^...' build`, which the diff does not touch), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build` with `engine.ts` restored from `24d350b45` (tree only) and the base `dist/` saved; the head build runs after `git checkout HEAD -- packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` with `git status` clean. The head `dist/index.mjs` carries `readRegistry` twice and the base copy 0 times, so each build is the one it claims to be.

All six declaration files are **byte-identical**. The raw diff of each is 0 lines. The util chunk name, `util-ByiLm3B6`, is the same at both ends.

- Normaliser, the ruling's one-liner verbatim (double-quoted unions): `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' FILE | sha256sum`. This package prints single-quoted literals, so on these files it changes nothing and normalised = raw. The third column is the same single class spelled with a single quote; it also matches. This cut does not depend on it, because the raw bytes are identical.
- **Positive control**, in the same run, on a copy of the head `util-ByiLm3B6.d.ts`: line 8318 `private isSystemLedgerObject;` made public (`isSystemLedgerObject;`, raw diff 2 lines) gives raw = ruled-normalised `c944677ee7e7c23a9ecabb6466a616a9f993d3e41fbee3b854527e039c7d19cd`, which differs from `1742a9cb…`. The single-quote normalisation gives `e86dbb567ef0…`, which differs from `bffd1b630dab…`.
- **Export lists**, loaded at run time from the built bundles (ESM `import()` and CJS `require`), are identical at base and head. `.` has 182 exports under ESM and 182 under CJS; `./core` has 54 and 54. The sorted lists hash `881616cc179189098182bd6b8a95701d9922f9677b786bc12e2d31c1adb0adaa` and `393e806906e876c2e020aa96617d54050a35ae63cd483b67d8e968b7b5390f49` at both ends (the same as cut 2's).

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4.

## Proof of move-only

- **Bodies, by AST token** (recursive `getChildren` leaves of the TypeScript parse). For each moved function, the parameters (without the added `this`), the return type, the `async` modifier and the body have the same token sequence as the base method: `checkDriversHealth` 251 tokens, `resolvePrimaryDatasource` 218 tokens, all SAME. Every body line is the base line less two leading spaces (36 and 39 lines, braces included). **Negative control:** one changed token in the moved `resolvePrimaryDatasource` (`'system-object-unbound'` misspelled in memory) makes the same check report DIFFER.
- **Class side.** The class has 317 members at base and at head. The 315 that did not move are byte-identical to base (full text, docblocks included). The 2 stubs keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `engine.ts`.** 234 of the 235 base statements outside the class are byte-identical at head. The other is the `@objectstack/spec/system` import less `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES`. The one new statement is the import of the new module.
- **The tests reach the moved bodies** through the stubs: `engine-driver-health.test.ts` (7 cases on `checkDriversHealth`, timeout and skip paths included), `engine-primary-datasource.test.ts` (every `resolvePrimaryDatasource` verdict), `engine-driver-eviction.test.ts` and `datasource-unavailable.test.ts`. All pass at head (below).

## Readers of the moved lines

- **ADR anchors (A2).** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine.ts.json`'s one paragraph is about the transaction seam (`buildDriverOptions`, `enforceTransactionOrigin`), neither of which moves. The ADR-0057 §3.6 mention in `resolvePrimaryDatasource`'s docblock stays on the stub; the one-line `// ADR-0057 §3.6` comment inside the body moves with it. No anchor entry describes a moved body, so none is added. `check:adr-anchors` exit 0 at both ends: 85 anchored files; **1,847 decision-letter citations on the anchored surface at base and at head**; 52,546 citations at both ends (6,610 files at base, 6,611 at head: the new module).
- **Liveness ledgers.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` exits 0 at head. No ledger points at either moved symbol.
- **Other path readers.** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,384 anchors resolve at head. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: 1 anchored file in the change set, 14 anchors judged, 0 lost.

## Direct dependants (A3)

The moved members are reached from `@objectstack/runtime` (`http-dispatcher.ts`'s `/ready` handler calls both) and named in `@objectstack/service-datasource`'s comments. I built their dependency closures (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime^...' --filter '@objectstack/service-datasource^...' build`, under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0) and ran `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/service-datasource typecheck` (VERDICT command-exit 0): `service-datasource` `tsc --noEmit` done; `runtime` `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck` OK; 0 `error TS` lines. Both read the published declarations, which are byte-identical above.

## For the next dispatch (cut 4)

- **Proposed area: Realtime publish** (the tail of the "Write guard and realtime publish" row): `publishDataEvent` (58-line body) and `publishBulkDataEvent` (55-line body).
  - Both private with explicit return types; no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site; no static read; no `engine.ts#…` path reader; no `vi.spyOn` or instance assignment on either, measured repo-wide.
  - 18 lines from the last 30 days (16 in `publishDataEvent`'s range, 2 in `publishBulkDataEvent`'s).
  - Host: three getters only (`realtimeService`, `logger`, `_registry`).
  - **Priced against the net-line rule:** 113 body lines out, about 2 × 7 stub lines and 3 import lines in, so `engine.ts` drops by roughly 95 lines.
- **Stays from that row:** `assertWriteAllowed`. `packages/spec/liveness/datasource.json` cites `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#assertWriteAllowed` as evidence, the same reason `resolveDatasourceBinding` stayed in cut 2. `setRealtimeService` and `listUnavailableDatasources` are 1–2-line bodies, shorter than a host literal.
- **Still waiting:** Roll-up summaries (spec-coupled, see cut 1); the Datasource registry (U = 3); Related-record expansion (`expandRelatedRecords` reads the private static `MAX_EXPAND_DEPTH`).

## Verification

All at head `7b61487ac`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`), under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0; 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held.
- `packages/objectql` suite (`vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`, under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0): 466 files, 1,899 suites, 8,700 tests, 8,700 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 56 families on the real diff at `7b61487ac` (stderr names the repo and the commit). All 56 were run, each exit code recorded before any pipe. 53 exit 0 on the first pass, and `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` exit 0 after the history deepening it names as its remedy (`git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-19`; it had refused with exit 2, CANNOT COMPUTE; ratio 98.1%). `--ran` reconciles: 56 accounted for, 54 run, 2 NOT MEASURED. CI runs both:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3: its pinned fixture commit is not in this shallow clone.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 54 export entries of other packages have no `dist/` (9 listed, "… 45 more"). The export lists above answer its question for this package.
- Hand gates, all exit 0: `check-adr-anchors` (base and head), `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`.
